sourceData.meaningMnemonic: If your <radical>soul</radical> is acting like the <radical>sun</radical> trapped in a <radical>net</radical> sitting on a <radical>stool</radical>, then people will <kanji>ridicule</kanji> you for your <kanji>laziness</kanji>. You're just sitting there, trapped and not moving.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: When people <kanji>ridicule</kanji> you, when you can't stop the <kanji>laziness</kanji>, you read <reading>man</reading>ga (<ja>まん</ja>). Manga helps you feel better about the mean things people say. Manga helps you feel like you're doing something, and that you aren't just a lazy person.
sourceData.meaningInfo: Your soul just doesn't want to move or do anything though... and that may look like laziness, but you can't help it. You wish your friends and family wouldn't ridicule you. You're going through enough, internally.
sourceData.readingInfo: Picture yourself reading manga and watch as the people who ridicule you and call you lazy fade away into the background. You're going to be okay.
